message: Even though it was an indoor training hall, colorful flowers unlike any I had ever seen bloomed in wild profusion.
On top of that, countless butterflies fluttered all around, swarming toward those nameless flowers or drifting away from them.
—Yet it was a little different from the dazzling image of butterflies dancing over a highland flower field.
The flowers were colorful, to be sure, yet somehow dull—faded rather than brilliantly hued.
Many looked showy enough at first glance, yet among them I could spot terribly plain ones, things resembling Rafflesia, and even what looked like carnivorous plants.
Even the butterflies swarming around them made me wonder if they might actually be moths.
...Though telling butterflies and moths apart is hard enough as it is. Apparently, it's actually butterflies that more often rest with their wings spread open.
About half of the ones flying around here right now could hardly be called pretty in either appearance or color, much like the flowers. Still, I hear there are butterflies like that too.
Not that I was actually trying to tell the butterflies from the moths like that, but—
As I strained my eyes and looked closely, from my right—a single beautiful butterfly was approaching me.
And the instant I focused my attention on it—the butterfly suddenly transformed into Ririmu, raising her Origami overhead.

name: Iori
message: 「Ngh... There！」
To counterattack, I reflexively swung my Origami as well.
—Not at the Ririmu I had just seen, however, but sweeping hard to the exact opposite side, to my left！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Gyaun？！」
A solid impact—and then Ririmu's shriek rang out.
The blade of the Ririmu I had just seen on my right lost its color, passing straight through my body and vanishing—

name: Yorishiro-kun
message: 「Barrier Jacket has fallen below the safety threshold. Please conclude the combat simulation.」
As that final announcement sounded, all the illusions vanished, and we were back in the usual indoor training hall.
I hurried over to Ririmu, who had fallen flat on her back, and offered her a hand.

name: Iori
message: 「Guess I put a bit too much force into that... Sorry, are you okay？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah... I'm fiine, I'm fiine. That was nothing, really.」
Ririmu reached out to take my hand—only to flinch with a sudden jolt and hesitate, before springing back to her feet on her own.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Still, you're as strong as ever, Sensei. And here I was sure I'd totally outsmarted you.」

name: Iori
message: 「On my end, it's still pretty much just instinct. My eyes were completely fooled, after all.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「There's no point if I can't throw you off right down to the bottom of your heart, y'know...」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha. All things considered, I've fought you plenty of times, Ririmu, and more than anything, I watch you pretty closely.」

name: Iori
message: 「Thanks to that, my heart might actually be harder to throw off now.」

name: Iori
message: 「What's wrong？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Uh... hmm... It's nothing！ I just felt a liiittle bit frustrated, that's all.」

name: Iori
message: 「Frustrated, huh. You really do hate losing too, Ririmu.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Of course I do！ My opponent freaks out at my illusions, gets totally thrown off, and goes down！ That's my aesthetic！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So losing kinda sucks, y'know？」

name: Iori
message: 「Was that illusion just now because of that frustration too? Your movements felt sluggish, or like you were hesitating.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Uh... well, not even making it to the main tournament at the Martial Festival is super lame, and totally not my aesthetic...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Even I get a little bummed out by that...」

name: Iori
message: 「That's a completely natural feeling, and an important one. Besides, that's even why you asked me for private lessons during summer break, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「It's great seeing you get so dedicated like this, and it makes me happy too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Uh... yeah, well... yeah, I guess so！」

name: Iori
message: 「...There's something behind that tone. Didn't you want to get stronger because you hated losing？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「O-Of course that's part of it too！ Isn't it obvious？ I've gotta train with Sensei so I can aesthetic, y'know！」

name: Iori
message: 「You're kinda using 'aesthetic' like a verb there, though.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, that's right！ I've gotta do my fashion research too！ Welp, Sensei, that's it for today's training！ See ya！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, Ririmu！」
With that one-sided goodbye, Ririmu hurried right off.

name: Iori
message: 「...Guess she wasn't too keen on talking about that.」
Maybe laying her feelings bare so directly is still a little embarrassing for her.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu's aesthetic, huh...」
That has to be Ririmu's very heart itself.
That's exactly why I want to touch it even more, to understand it...

name: Asahi
message: 「I found you, Iori-sensei.」
As I was deep in thought, Asahi suddenly entered the training ground.

name: Iori
message: 「Oh？ What’s the matter, Asahi？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I was looking for you because I wanted to ask for some personal tutoring.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, is that so. Well, in that case... I’m free right now, for the time being.」

name: Iori
message: 「But doesn't this training ground have a reservation booked next？」

name: Asahi
message: 「That’s fine. I’ve already made a reservation for the outdoor training ground. So, let’s go right away.」

name: Iori
message: 「W-wait, you don't have to pull me like that, I'm coming！」
Even though I felt a bit guilty, or rather, felt like I had unfinished business, I let Asahi pull me along.

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Well, the fashion research isn't a lie either, so...？」
There’s no one around, but I make an excuse to myself anyway.
...After I ran away from Sensei.
I didn't have any plans to go anywhere, so I just wandered into a convenience store and, remembering, bought a fashion magazine. It's not like that research is a lie, either.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Both are important to me, you know~」
As I was muttering that and reading, while walking along... suddenly, I heard a voice.

name: Iori
message: 「I never thought it would turn into this.」

name: Ririmu
message: （Huh, isn't that Iori-n？ Could he be chasing after me！？）
At that thought, my heart skipped a beat—
Or so I thought, but I immediately realized I was mistaken.
I ducked behind something to take a look, and around Iori were familiar figures: one, two, three...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I won't lose this time！ Ah！ I mean, I won last time, so it's not 'this time' but 'this time too', right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「You shouldn't expect such a fluke to happen so many times, you know？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What did you say！」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't start fighting before we even get to the training ground. Everyone is going to do special training equally.」

name: Ririmu
message: （Ah... so they're all heading to the outdoor training ground. Yeah yeah, got it, I get it.）
I get it, but... somehow, I feel all muddled inside.

name: Iori
message: 「Still, when did things get so crowded, anyway?」

name: Asahi
message: 「Exactly. It was supposed to be just the two of us, Iori-sensei and me.」

name: Ririmu
message: （It was just the two of us with me before that, though—！？）
...Well, I was the one who ran away, though.

name: Ririmu
message: （No, wait, it's not like I ran away—I just got a little embarrassed and felt like doing some fashion research, okay...？!）
Making excuses to myself... I peek at them a little longer.
They're all chatting away so happily, even talking seriously about their training plans and stuff...
They're going to head to the training grounds now, and I bet they'll have a great time training seriously there too.

name: Ririmu
message: （...Come to think of it, I feel like something like this happened before...）
That time I skipped class, and Iorin put on an act to try and do something about it, right?
It was an act back then, but... right now it's probably for real. And it's not like I'm even skipping or anything.
Besides, the way I feel right now isn't the same as back then.
I feel way more unsettled than before, and jealous... and honestly, super frustrated.

name: Ririmu
message: （...Well, duh, of course I do. Because...）
Because I—I'm in love with Iorin.
That's why I'm so unsettled and nothing's going right. I'm supposed to be the one throwing people off, yet Iorin's the one messing with my aesthetic.

name: Ririmu
message: （At this rate, forget Jindou, even my fashion won't go right... I really need to settle this properly, but...）
Still, should I be the one to tell him？
No way. Definitely not. Impossible. That's totally not my aesthetic.
Then what am I supposed to do？
Not confess, yet still date Iorin. Is that even a thing？
...Hm？ Wait, wait. That just means I don't confess, right？ Wouldn't it be totally fine if Iorin's the one who says it？

name: Ririmu
message: （That's it! If Iorin falls for me and confesses to me first, that's totally fine! Plus, doesn't that fit my aesthetic so well!？）
Huge breakthrough！ I'm seriously a genius！

name: Ririmu
message: （Awesome！ Then I've gotta figure out a way to make Iorin confess to me right away！）
...So, walking along while thinking about it is all well and good, except...

name: Ririmu
message: （Seriously, what do I do... I've never even thought about romance or how guys think）
Plus, everyone I know is a rival, so there's no way I can ask them.
Who else knows a lot about that kind of stuff...

name: Ririmu
message: （Oh, right! Senpai's shop should be around here somewhere. Senpai's gotta know all about this kind of stuff!）

name: Ririmu
message: （Plus, Senpai is closer in age to Iorin, so that’s way better！ I’m honestly such a genius！）
Just you wait, Iorin！
I’m gonna use the info from Senpai to take Iorin down and get him to confess to me, for sure！
Today, I had Iorin tutor me again.
…But the reason I asked for his help today is a little—just a tiny bit—different from usual！
It’s obviously to put my operation based on Senpai’s info into action！

name: Ririmu
message: （Operation #1: A super blatant appeal！）

name: Iori
message: 「Good work, Ririmu. You seemed to be doing great today. Your movements were sharp and energetic.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nfufu, maybe. …But thanks to that, I’m pretty sweaty, huh？ Whew, it’s hot, so hot.」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, I guess so. You should go take a shower soon.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm？ Could it be that Teacher is imagining my shower scene or something？」

name: Iori
message: 「W-what are you saying? No way. You might catch a cold if you stay like that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha, I’m just kidding. You’re way too flustered.」

name: Iori
message: 「Honestly…」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But you know? When it’s this hot, doesn't it make you want to go to the beach instead of just taking a shower?」

name: Iori
message: 「The beach… well, that wouldn't be bad.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Right, right？ Besides, I mean, though I’m saying it myself, don’t you think I’ve got a pretty good figure？」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh！？ That is, well, how should I put it…」
Nfufu… Iorin is looking at my body, he’s totally looking. Time to take it a step further…！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, don't you want to see me in a swimsuit？ If it’s in front of Teacher, I might even wear something a biiit daring, you know？」
As I say that, I press right up against him！

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, Ririmu…！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Mmh… Teacher, why are you backing away a bit！ And why are you holding your hands up like that?」

name: Iori
message: 「I-I, well, it’s just that you suddenly got so close… and the hands are just, well… an appeal that I’m not touching you？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You don't need to make an appeal like that！ I want you to make the opposite appeal instead！」

name: Iori
message: 「I’ve never heard of an 'appeal that I’m touching you'…」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh… seriously, you’re so stiff.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well anyway, going to the beach itself might not be a bad idea. We could do some running drills on the sand too, so maybe I'll ask everyone else.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh? What're you talking about? It's supposed to be just you and me, Sensei!」

name: Iori
message: 「No, a teacher and a student going on a trip just the two of them is definitely a no-go. If we're going, we're going with everyone in Takamura Class！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh, come on！ There's no point if it's not just me and you, Sensei！」
I already knew this, of course, but Iorin really is a tough opponent...

name: Ririmu
message: （Operation #2: Operation Capture His Stomach！）
...Even though I say that, I'm not actually all that good at cooking.

name: Ririmu
message: （But that's where... this comes in！）

name: Iori
message: 「Grabbing ice cream at a convenience store on the way back from special training kinda makes me feel like I'm back in my student days.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I *am* a student, though.」
After doing special training at the outdoor training grounds, we eat delicious ice cream from the convenience store together！ That'll totally capture his stomach！
...I'm pretty sure the plan Senpai told me about was kinda pointless unless it's homemade, though...
Oh well, my real plan starts right here anyway！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, Sensei？ Wanna trade bites... Wait, huh？ Yours is just crushed ice！」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？ Oh yeah, I figured it's not too sweet and it's good for cooling off.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「We can't trade bites with *that*！」

name: Iori
message: 「Trade for one piece of ice... maybe？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Totally pointless！ Geez, Sensei, you really are a tough opponent even in stuff like this...」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm an opponent...？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whatever, it's fine. I got this one—a popsicle！ When it comes to frozen treats, it's gotta be stick-shaped, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「True, those are pretty good too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Mhaha, right, right？ Wanna let me give you a bite？ After I've licked it.」

name: Iori
message: 「Wha—？！ N-No, that's...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha, just kidding♪ For a Sensei who picks crushed ice at a time like this, your punishment is that you don't get a single bite.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Instead, make sure you watch me eat it reeeally deliciously, okay？」
After teasing him like that, I take this popsicle like this... and lick it slowly with my tongue...

name: Ririmu
message: 「Mmch, shlrp... shlurp... mmmch, mnah...」

name: Iori
message: 「Ri, Ririmu...？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Retchu, ngh... mmmfufu... what’s wrong, Sensei？ Your face looks kinda red, doesn’t it？ Nchu, reroh...」
Without putting the ice cream in her mouth, she sticks out her tongue and swirls it around...
Man, this is super embarrassing！
I thought combining this with the original plan would make it the ultimate strategy, but this is way too embarrassing！ Who even thought of this！ Wait, it was me！

name: Iori
message: 「Uh, Ririmu...？ That way of eating is a bit...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Mnn, mnnn...？ I’m just eating it normally, aren’t I？ You know, ice cream is meant to be... hoa... licked, right...？ Nn, chu, reru... nreroh... mnn...」
But there’s no backing out now that I’ve come this far！
Just gotta go for it！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nchu... ngh...！ Sensei, what do I do...？ The ice cream dripped a little...♪」
As she says that, she opens her collar to flaunt her cleavage...！！

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, what are you doing！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wha, what do you mean？ The ice cream dripped and it’s gonna get my uniform dirty, so I’m just moving it away, right？ Here, Sensei, look. Some white ice cream got into my chest area...」

name: Iori
message: 「...H-here, use my handkerchief！ It’ll be a disaster if it stains！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Eh, ah, un... uhm... that’s it！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, Sensei...？ Do you wanna watch me wipe it off？」

name: Iori
message: 「Wipe it off while I’m not looking！」
With that, Iori-rin turned his back immediately.

name: Ririmu
message: （I did something this embarrassing and he won't even look at me...！ Iori-rin really might be a tough opponent...）
...Well, it was pretty embarrassing to be stared at too much, so it actually helped a little.

name: Ririmu
message: （Agh... nothing is working at all！）
I’ve tried all sorts of things since then, but Iori-rin just won't budge, won't confess, and won't even try to pounce on me！
Well, if he actually did try to pounce, I’d probably scream. Maybe.

name: Ririmu
message: （But you know, there should be something more, right？ Like him staring at my body, or even if he doesn't confess, getting so excited he pins me against the wall or something）
Venting her frustrations in her heart, she wanders around the station front.
Everyone around looks so happy, and there are even couples walking by, which just makes me feel worse.
Really, that should've been me right now！

name: Ririmu
message: （And today's special training was suddenly canceled too...！ Could it be that yesterday's pretend-to-trip-and-hug-from-behind plan actually weirded him out a little...）
Come to think of it, Iorin froze up for a bit when I hugged him, so was I really laying it on too thick？ I'd seriously hate it if I creeped him out... What do I do...

name: Ririmu
message: （I thought that kinda vibe might be a yes, too, but maybe it was a no-go for Iorin...）

name: Ririmu
message: （I did all that and he didn't even make a move... Could it be I seriously don't have a shot...）

name: Ririmu
message: （No, no！ That's impossible！ No way！ That's totally not my vibe at all！）

name: Ririmu
message: （Even if I don't have a shot right now, turning a no into a yes is what I do best！ I'm definitely gonna make Iorin—！）

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, huh？」
Just then, a figure suddenly steps out from the side, making me stop dead in my tracks.
They must've noticed me too, stopping at the same time as we look each other in the face.
And that's when it hits me—this is Arakawa Sonomi.
It's all in the past now, sure, but it's still a little awkward, so after we both go quiet for a second...
It'd be weird to just ignore her and walk off now, so I'm the one who breaks the silence.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Just so you know, I'm not gonna lose next time.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「That's the first thing out of your mouth?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wouldn't it creep you out if I suddenly went, 'Oh, good day, Sonomi-san'？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Yeah, fair enough.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So, what're you up to？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Huh? Why the hell do I gotta tell you?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No reason？ Not like I'm begging you to tell me or anything？ I was just asking, y'know？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hmph, is that right.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nfufu~♪ Oh, wait, that thing in your hand. That's a bag from the thrift shop over there, right？ The one that mostly sells clothes？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Huh？ Where I buy my clothes is none of your damn business.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, scary face... Relax, I don't think there's anything wrong with it. Besides, I shop there sometimes too, you know.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hmph... Makes me sick.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So mean！」
Ugh, seriously, what is with her！
...Or so I thought, until I stared hard at Arakawa-paisen and noticed something.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, Arakawa-paisen, your uniform's a little different from the normal ones, right？ Did you mod it yourself？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...What？ Don't tell me even you're gonna start yapping about school rules now？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha！ No way I'd do that. I mean, I don't even remember the school rules.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Yeah, figures you wouldn't. Then what is it？ Gonna say my mods look tacky or somethin'？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No, no, the exact opposite. I was just thinking, hey, maybe Paisen's actually got pretty good taste.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Huh...? What's with you all of a sudden?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Like, it really suits you, y'know？ Feels like you've got your own whole vibe going on, and you tailored your uniform to match it.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Sh-Shut up... Quit being creepy all of a sudden. What is this? Some new tactic? Butter me up first so you can hit me with somethin' annoying again?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh? Like I'd ever pull that. When it comes to fashion, I never lie, and I don't do flattery, okay?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Then what the hell is your deal, anyway?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What do you mean？ I'm just saying Arakawa-paisen's fashion sense is a total yes, like, way on point!」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I told you！ Stop complimenting me over every little thing！ Cut it out！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaat？ Who gets mad about having their outfit complimented？ That's impossible!」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Well, it's possible！ Sheesh...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, if you ask me, it's still just a tiny bit short of perfection, though. Your footwear's kinda neglected, and I'd wanna see some nail art too.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hah, like I've got the time or money to waste on nails.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Aww, really? Even though you've got such great style?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I only dress like this so nobody messes with me. I couldn't care less about fashion or whatever. Even today, I was just out buying clothes for my little sister.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I'm gonna go pro as soon as I can so I can give my little brother and sister a good life. I don't have time to fool around looking flashy like you.」
She jabs a finger at me provocatively. More importantly, though—

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm... So you're aiming to go pro, huh?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Obviously. There's no other path for me. I'm even working on a finishing move that'll get the crowd hyped once I'm a pro.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「That teacher of yours even told me that if I wanna go pro, it's better to have somethin' flashy like that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Wait, were you asking Iorin for advice！？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Well, he talks to me sometimes, so I just kinda did.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Going to Iorin for advice is kinda unfaaaair! He's my Iorin!」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Huh? Since when the hell did he become yours?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, I mean... that's the plan？ Kinda...」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Well, I always figured teachers were all the same, y'know, but that guy feels kinda different.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「On that front, I'm actually a little jealous of you guys in Takamura Class.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heheh♪ Riiight, riiight？ After all, he's my Iorin, y'know~」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I told you, he's not yours.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Iorin's seriously awesome, y'know. He even sees right through my illusions like it's nothing. ...Well, that part's a little frustrating, though.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But it's not just that he's strong—Iorin's got tons of other amazing things about him, y'know？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「First off, it's definitely the way he teaches, or like, how he gets you in the mood to try. Like with me, before I even realize it, I'm all motivated, and I'm like, 'Ugh, Iorin's totally got me dancing in the palm of his hand.'」

name: Ririmu
message: 「And then he's so nice! Somehow he plays me like a fiddle and gets me doing stuff, and I'm like, 'Damn it,' and then right when I feel like that, he's all gentle with me!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It kinda feels unfair, y'know? Like, isn't that cheating? But I just end up forgiving him anyway. I wonder if he's playing me again, but I end up forgiving that too！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「And yet he's strict when he needs to be, so just when I'm thinking he'll let it slide 'cause he's nice, he suddenly gets super firm, and it totally makes my heart skip a beat—like, how could anyone not fall for that！？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Yeah, I dunno about that...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, and of course his face is pretty... Well, at first I thought he wasn't all that, but now when I really stare at him, I kinda feel like he's handsome？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「The way he fights is great too. When I'm fighting Iorin, it really feels like a whole world of its own！ Plus his voice is kinda mature and soothing, like—」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Argh, that's enough already！ Just how much are you into that teach！?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I-I-I-It's not like that or anything...！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hah, I'm not interested in that kind of stuff. Do whatever you want.」
Arakawa Sonomi gave a wry smile and walked away.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I-It's not like that~！ Seriously, it's nothing like that！」
I shouted at Arakawa Sonomi's retreating back.
Without really meaning to, I wandered over to my usual shopping area.

name: Ririmu
message: （I mean, this is totally my home turf, right？ Like, y'know？）

name: Ririmu
message: （Buuut I don't really have any plans or anything. Since I came all this way, maybe I actually will look around at clothes？）

name: Ririmu

What appeared inside was food with a unique, unmistakably Ririmu-like design that I had never seen before.
Leave it to Ririmu. To think she'd even be considerate about something like this.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright then, thanks for the food！」
Right away, I pick up a piece of something that looks like taro covered in a thick, amber―colored sauce―

name: Iori
message: 「Nom... munch, munch...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well？ Well？ Is it good？ Is it fire？ Totally hype？！」

name: Iori
message: 「......Yeah, it's delicious！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Really？！ You're not lying？！ It's actually good？！」

name: Iori
message: 「I wouldn't lie about that. As proof, look how easily I can pop 'em right in. Nom, munch, munch... chomp.」
True to my word, I toss them into my mouth one after another.
Watching me do so, Ririmu beams with a look of pure joy and emotion.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehehe. Maybe I really am a genius? Even if I don't normally cook, I can totally nail it when it counts, y'know?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, I did think it turned out pretty decent myself？ So I guess it's kinda obvious it'd be delicious, or whatever.」
Saying that, Ririmu reaches her chopsticks toward the same dish.
Maybe it was too slippery with sauce to grab properly, because she stabs it with her chopsticks and brings it to her mouth—

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nom. Mmm, mmm......」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Bleh？! What is this, it's disgusting! Ugh, so gross... Ptui, ptui!」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa？ What's wrong？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Don't 'what's wrong' me！ Gross...！ This is awful！ I know I'm the one who made it, but it's disgusting！」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？ Does it taste bad？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What is this, what flavor even is this？ It tastes like a dump truck crashed into muddy water or something.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's a flavor I've never heard of before.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm saying it's that gross！ How are you eating it with a straight face, Iorin？！ Wait, are you just trying to spare my feelings？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I genuinely think it tastes good.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Iorin, are you actually completely tone-deaf when it comes to taste？」

name: Iori
message: 「No way. Sure, the seasoning is a little unique, but... you made this for me, right, Ririmu？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I did, but... I almost want to deny it.」

name: Iori
message: 「My girlfriend poured her heart into making this food for me, so a slightly unique seasoning isn't going to make it taste bad. I'm savoring all those feelings along with it, after all.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Well, I mean... it does make me a little happy to hear you say that, y'know？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But I kinda wanted to make something normally delicious, or rather, I thought I was making something like that...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sigh... I guess home cooking just isn't really my vibe after all」

name: Iori
message: 「Personally, I'd even like you to make more for me. Chomp, munch, munch」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're seriously still eating it... Well, I'm happy though」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, by the way, Ririmu, you mentioned muddy water earlier, right」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Oh... yeah. You mean the taste of my cooking？」

name: Iori
message: 「Muddy water didn't taste like this at all. I've drunk it as part of training before, though」

name: Ririmu
message: 「............Iorin, back then, your sense of taste really」

name: Iori
message: 「No it didn't！」
The next day after that—this time, during Setsugekka's private coaching.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Orya, orya, oryaaaaah！」
Carefully parrying each of Setsugekka's sharp, consecutive slashes one by one, I check the trajectory of her blade.
It's just our usual special training in the form of a normal sparring match, same as always, except...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「An opening...！ Right thereee！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa there！？」
I twist my body on reflex to block a strike launched from my blind spot.
Had my reaction been even a split second slower, it would have been a direct hit.
...No, rather than calling it an attack from my blind spot in the first place...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Guh, so close！ I almost had you！」

name: Iori
message: 「That really was cutting it close... About ten centimeters closer and it would've hit me」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, that's not cutting it close at all！ You could dodge that easily！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Besides, Sensei, weren't you looking away just now？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ugh... well, that's...」
Just as she pointed out. For that single instant, even if it was just my eyes, I had shifted my gaze away from Setsugekka.
Specifically—I had looked over toward Ririmu, our female manager, who was watching the training session from behind Setsugekka.
Still, while I obviously love Ririmu, I would never get distracted during coaching for that reason alone.
Even so, the reason I ended up looking over there... and the reason my gaze keeps getting drawn back there even now...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ha！ You're looking away again！ Doryaaaaaah！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa！？」
Once again, I barely manage to block an attack from my blind spot―a blind spot created because I was looking away―at the very last moment.
After doing so, I jump back a little and strike an apologetic pose toward a pouting Setsugekka.

name: Iori
message: 「N-No, sorry. There's just a lot going on...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A lot going on... behind me？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, no！ You don't need to turn around！ More importantly, look, I'll be fine this time！ Let's resume our special training！」
I hastily stop Setsugekka as she tries to look behind her, getting back into my stance as I say that.
Though she looks puzzled, Setsugekka faces me once again.
I can't let her turn around right now. Because—

name: Iori
message: （Why the hell is Ririmu pulling her clothes open over there...！！）

name: Ririmu
message: （Nhehehe, he's looking, he's looking！ Operation success！）
During today's special training, my eyes keep locking right onto Iorin's over and over！ In other words, my plan is a total win！
Iorin is—weak to naughty stuff！

name: Ririmu
message: （I figured if I flashed him a peek of my boobs and panties like this, he'd definitely look my way, but I never thought it'd work *this* well~）

name: Ririmu
message: （Hehe~. If it's like this, I should've just done this from the start~）
Well, because of that, Iorin's getting yelled at by Secchan and having a bunch of close calls, though... hey, this is part of special training too, right？

name: Ririmu
message: （...Also, showing my boobs outdoors like this really is kinda embarrassing even for me, though...）

name: Ririmu
message: （But hey, Iorin's the only one looking, right？ In fact, I'm making sure *only* Iorin can see！）

name: Ririmu
message: （And Iorin keeps staring only at me, so we're totally head over heels for each other, aren't we？ Well, we're lovers, so we've already been head over heels for ages anyway.）
Anyway, with this, Iorin's attention on me is going way up starting today！ I really am glad I became the team manager~.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright... let's change up the situation a bit. Ririmu, hand Setsugekka one of the Origami over there. From your perspective, the second one from the right.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Ah, okay, okaay.」

name: Ririmu
message: （Come to think of it, we're using a bunch of different Origami today, aren't we？ Well, I'm the manager, so I guess I gotta do this kind of work once in a while~）
I grab the specified Origami, go over to Secchan, swap it for the Origami she was using, and head back.
But I never go down for nothing！ The moment Secchan turns her back, I flip up my skirt just enough for a tiny peek toward Iorin...！

name: Iori
message: 「Guh...！ W-Well then, Setsugekka, let's try that again using the Origami with those settings！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why are you so flustered？」

name: Iori
message: 「It's your imagination！」

name: Ririmu
message: （Alright, it's working like a charm！）
He can say whatever he wants, it's totally obvious his heart's racing, y'know？

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, Setsugekka, strike at me with that！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Okaaay. Here I come, Sensei... Hyaaaah！」
The special training starts up again, and Iorin and Secchan begin fighting.
At first, I just watch them normally for a while. I'm not gonna spam it over and over. 'Cause I'm a strategist！

name: Ririmu
message: （And right when Iorin lets his guard down... another quick peek of my boobs！）

name: Iori
message: 「Ngh...! R-Ririmu! In the meantime, tweak the settings on that Origami over there for me!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Tweak the Origami？ Me？」
He suddenly hits me with that while fighting Secchan. Oho, trying to stop me from launching my attacks, are we？

name: Iori
message: 「The basics of being a female manager is all about support！ I'm counting on you！ The settings details are written on that paper over there！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaat？ Well, fine, I guess？」
Reluctantly taking his orders... yet still flashing another quick peek of my boobs！

name: Iori
message: 「Ghh...！！ Ah, and Ririmu！ Once you're done with that, go restock the drinks too！ We need to replenish our nutrients right after special training, so make it snappy！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaaat？!」
Iorin keeps piling more work on me！
But I don't wanna lose either, so I tweak the settings, flash my boobs, flash my panties, then go shopping, and when I get back, strike a naughty pose—

name: Ririmu
message: （Ugh, I'm way too busy, this is super exhausting！）

name: Ririmu
message: 「Haaah, a female manager's job is seriously way too brutal... And Iorin's such a sadist...」
A lot had happened, but—finally, a day off.
As promised, I ended up going on a shopping date with Ririmu, though.

name: Iori
message: 「Did I really do anything that sadistic...？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You totally did. You dumped a crazy ton of work on me, y'know?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Having to do all of that while sneaking in little naughty stunts in between to grab Iorin's attention is seriously hard work！」

name: Iori
message: 「The latter part had nothing to do with being a female manager, though—you were just doing that on your own, Ririmu.」
Honestly, I had a pretty rough time dealing with it myself...

name: Iori
message: 「I mean, why did you even start doing that in the first place？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, back during Operation: Make Iorin Confess, you said it actually worked pretty well on you, right？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Figured maybe if I did naughty stuff like that again, you'd pay attention to me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Why right then, of all times...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well... I mean...」
Whether out of embarrassment or shyness, Ririmu looked away and pouted.
Fiddling with her hair with her fingertips, almost as if trying to hide her face.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Come on... you were only ever watching other girls, Iorin, right？ Even though I'm your girlfriend.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, yeah... it's one-on-one coaching. Gotta keep a close eye on them.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I know that! It just felt kinda frustrating!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I only started being a female manager so I could be with you in the first place, Iorin, and it didn't even feel like we were together at all.」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that so... Guess I made you feel lonely, huh.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, hold up, hold up! It's not like that, so no apologizing or anything!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I really don't wanna be one of those high-maintenance girls. ...Well, okay, maybe I was being a little bit like that.」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, no you weren't. Honestly, I'm happy you care about me that much.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Agh, jeez, this is super embarrassing... I'm being way too lame~！」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm telling you, you're not.」

name: Iori
message: 「I was happy to have you nearby, Ririmu, and I loved the bento too. As for that naughty stuff... saying I was happy about it makes me sound like a pervert, but it definitely worked on me again.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Really...？ Oh, well, I could tell the naughty stuff was working, though.」
It's pretty embarrassing that she noticed that, though.

name: Iori
message: 「And honestly, your work as a female manager really helped me out too. Thanks to you, the one-on-one coaching went even smoother than usual.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hehe... you think so？ Well, I did try my best, right？ Plain behind-the-scenes work totally wasn't my vibe, but it was a pretty good experience, I guess.」

name: Iori
message: 「Thanks, Ririmu. ...Oh, I know！ Since you did so much, how about I get you a present to thank you for all your hard work?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, seriously！？ A present from Iorin！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah. Though I didn't actually prepare anything beforehand, so I was thinking I'd ask what you want and go from there.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That's way more than enough！ Getting a present from Iorin—man, I'm so glad I became a girl manager♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Oh, it's not like I only did it for a present or anything, okay？」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, I know. So, Ririmu, is there anything you want？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Something I want, huh... Let's see...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Ah, wait, it's Iorin we're talking about here. Better not make it anything too expensive, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't worry about your boyfriend-and-teacher's wallet.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「A house, then.」

name: Iori
message: 「I suppose a little bit of worry is unavoidable.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha！ Well, I'm just kidding. Even I know better than that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Let's save the detached house for the two of us to live in for another time, when we can think it over together♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah—someday, the two of us together.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hehehe♪ Well then, let's just wander around for now. I'll think about all sorts of stuff while we walk.」

name: Iori
message: 「Good idea. Maybe something will catch your eye as we walk. Let's look around while enjoying our date.」
With that, we started walking toward the shopping area.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm... A present, huh... What should I go with?」

name: Iori
message: 「There are tons of different shops here, so you've got plenty to choose from.」
Ririmu mulled over her options, her eyes darting excitedly from shop to shop.
Just seeing her have this much fun made offering to buy her something more than worth it.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, there's a cosmetics shop! Let's go take a quick look!」

name: Iori
message: 「Makeup, huh? That definitely feels very you, Ririmu. Do you have a certain type you prefer?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, yeah. You know, favorite brands, ones that suit my skin—there's all kinds of stuff to consider.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Plus it changes depending on the season, and depending on my outfit, and sometimes even depending on the weather!」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that how it works...? Sounds like a lot of work.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, you gotta be that picky if you want to pull off your aesthetic. I mean, it's my own aesthetic—it'd be such a letdown if I didn't even match it myself, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「I really think it's amazing how you have such a solid aesthetic and throw yourself into it like that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehehe... Iorin, you're laying on the praise way too thick all of a sudden♪」

name: Iori
message: 「I mean it. So, what do you wanna do？ Wanna go with cosmetics？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, that'd be nice too, but... they're still consumables at the end of the day, y'know?」

name: Iori
message: 「What about some high-end stuff you only use on dates with me？ Like, we'd even go on dates just so you can use it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, you're talking like some romance pro for a guy like you, Iorin！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, 'for a guy like me' is pretty rude!」
I definitely can't tell her I've been secretly studying up since we started dating！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha！ Well, I guess that's one way to do it, but for me it's probably still a no-go.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean, my aesthetic includes how everything pairs together, right？ Even if something's high-end, it's pointless if it doesn't match.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see... That's pretty deep.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yep, it really is. Anyway, let's check out the next place for now.」

name: Iori
message: 「This is... that clothing store we went to before, right?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It's one of my favorites, after all. They've always got good stuff here.」
Walking happily through the store—Ririmu suddenly picking up an outfit as she passed by.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, look, look. This is one of the store's originals—don't you think it's pretty good？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ooh, I see. It's definitely a little unique, and it looks like it'd fit your aesthetic, Ririmu. Like... a pink outer-space kind of vibe.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yes, that's it！ Leave it to Iorin, you totally get it♪ That spacey, kinda awesome feel is the best, right? Like, full of passion?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's some fiery passion.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Uh-huh！ It's all about the aesthetic.」
...For some reason, I feel like the people around us are shooting us looks saying, 'What on earth are those two talking about?'
Either way, we didn't pay it any mind and wandered around the store together.
And every now and then, Ririmu picking up some piece of clothing.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, this one... the design is nice, just the color is a little...」

name: Iori
message: 「Seems like a pretty common color scheme, though. Not quite doing it for you, Ririmu？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Because it's so common, it feels a bit too safe？ If it were me, I'd make this part more like... oh, wait, if I did that, I might as well change the whole design...」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha. I can already see glimpses of your original brand.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nfufu, well yeah. I'm not planning on just putting out altered stuff, but this kind of thing is all about building up day-to-day experience, y'know~」
She's surprisingly diligent and steady when it comes to stuff like this. Guess she's more of a hands-on learner than a textbook one.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, this is the men's section... Wait, Iorin, wouldn't stuff around here look super good on you？」

name: Iori
message: 「Y-You think so？ It's a little flashy, though.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Trust me, it's good！ We tried it with AR before, right? Seeing the real thing in person gives off a slightly different vibe, y'know?」

name: Iori
message: 「True, I can definitely see that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I wanna do menswear too, so using you as a reference is totally perfect, Iorin. See, we really are the ultimate match, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, yeah. If I can help out with your goal, Ririmu, I'm more than happy to.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That's my Iorin, so sweet~♪」
Chatting like that, we made a full loop around the store...
When we arrived back near the entrance, Ririmu suddenly seemed to realize something.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Iorin... I just made a huge discovery...」

name: Iori
message: 「What is it？ Did you find something you want？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, the thing is...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Come to think of it, any clothes I actually want, I've obviously already bought for myself！」

name: Iori
message: 「Good point...！」

name: Iori
message: 「It's just like with cosmetics—it's all about how things coordinate, so getting one random piece wouldn't really do you much good, huh.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha! You really do learn fast about this stuff, Iorin! Truly worthy of being my boyfriend~♪」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, comes with the territory of dating you, Ririmu.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, let's look for something else for now, then.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, was there anything else I wanted...」
So we started walking through the shopping area again—
And where we stopped was in front of a specialty Jindou gear shop.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Stuff like this might actually be pretty nice？」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, I see. Gear for Jindou doesn't really feel like a consumable, either.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I can carry it around all the time, and it feels like your Iorin Power will make me stronger！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha. Still, if it's Jindou gear, I wonder what'd even be good」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm... maybe a cute strap to attach to the hilt？」

name: Iori
message: 「I really don't think they have that... Nobody normally puts one on」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Then how about cute deco stickers to put on an Origami's blade！」

name: Iori
message: 「Definitely not that either！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaat？ For a Jindou specialty shop, they don't have anything」

name: Iori
message: 「Those aren't even Jindou supplies in the first place...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「The shop I go to carries them, though」

name: Iori
message: 「They do！？ Where on earth is there such an outrageous Jindou shop...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nope, it's a general store」

name: Iori
message: 「Then that has nothing to do with it！ They probably aren't selling them as Jindou supplies anyway」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Even though it's called Jindou General Store？」

name: Iori
message: 「That's even less relevant！」

name: Iori
message: 「Besides, you don't put deco stickers or straps on yours either, Ririmu, right？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, that's 'cause they'd ban me from matches if I did」

name: Iori
message: 「I mean, that's just... unavoidable」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Personally, I wanna bring out more of a vibe with my Origami too」

name: Iori
message: 「Come to think of it, there probably aren't many people who think about fashion in that area」

name: Ririmu
message: 「When I launch my own original brand, I wanna put effort into stuff like that too~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Lending a helping hand to Ikusabito all over the world who share my struggles！ Something like that？」

name: Iori
message: 「That's pretty grand」
No idea how many people like that actually exist, though.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, you gotta dream big~！ Anyway, let's head to the next place」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh? So you don't want Jindou gear after all?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I just realized, pretty much everything you use in Jindou is kinda rugged, or like, bulky, y'know？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean, that stuff isn't bad or anything, I just feel like it's lacking in romance as a present.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, that's a fair point.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So, next up...」

name: Iori
message: 「As for other things you might want, Ririmu...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Like female manager gear！」

name: Iori
message: 「Seriously going full female manager...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Actually, nope！ Forget I said that！」

name: Iori
message: 「That was fast...！」
...And so, with one thing and another, we made our rounds and looked everywhere, though.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Haa. I couldn't find anything after all...」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, well, it can't be helped. I did spring it on you out of nowhere.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「When I think about how it's a present from you, Iorin, I end up overthinking everything...」

name: Iori
message: 「It's really not something you need to stress over that much, though.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Still, it's the first present since we became a couple, y'know？ I really wanna make something like that special.」

name: Iori
message: 「I am happy that you're putting so much thought into it, though.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, there's no rush, so just let me know whenever you think of something.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You won't forget if I don't get it right now, will you？」

name: Iori
message: 「I won't. Don't worry.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm... Then maybe I'll think about it a little longer.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, that's right！ I gotta get something for you too, Iorin！」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？ Me？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Now that I think about it, like this I'm the only one getting anything, right？ So I'm gonna get you a present too, Iorin！」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I couldn't let you do that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「My present was for working hard as the team manager, right？ But you were working way harder that whole time, Iorin. So think of it as a big 'good job, Iorin'！」

name: Iori
message: 「I appreciate you wanting to reward me, but... even if we're dating, having a student buy me something is really...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It's totally fine. Even I know that much. Believe it or not, I'm the type who knows how to let a guy save face, ya know.」

name: Iori
